messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — PD#98765 — inference-eu-high-5xx — 5xx rate spike on /v1/generate (trigger: 5xx > 3% over 5m)
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident assigned to maria (primary on-call)
maria: Ack, grabbing it. Pulling logs from eu-inference cluster now.
jon (sre): I'm on metrics — seeing KV cache eviction storm and 2 nodes reporting OOM in ded-pool-eu.
maria: Starting mitigation: reroute traffic away from suspect nodes and partial shift to dedicated pool. Command: `curl -X POST https://infra.internal/api/v1/pools/placements -d '{"pool":"dedicated-eu","weight":0.7}'`
ops-sre: Scaling up ded-pool-eu by +2 GPUs (requested). ETA ~90s.
maria: Customer impact: intermittent 5xx for ~2-3% of requests, a handful of customers reporting errors/latency >2s. CC @sam (cust-success)
sam (cust-success): Notifying top affected customers with heads-up and mitigation plan. Will send template update after ETA.
ben (eng): Any recent rollout that could explain this? I see a model cohort pushed at 12:40 UTC — fallback should be on.
maria: Checking deploys now — model rollout active but no infra deploys. Fallbacks are enabled, still investigating correlation.
jon (sre): Isolating bad node group: nodepool-a1 shows high eviction + memory pressure. Taking node-a1-12 OOS for restart: `kubectl cordon node-a1-12 && kubectl drain node-a1-12 --ignore-daemonsets && kubectl delete pod -l nodeName=node-a1-12 -n prod`
ops-sre: Node restart + pod reschedule done. Observability: 5xx rate dropping from 3.2% -> 0.9% over last 3m.
maria: Good sign. Keep monitoring. We'll run canary traffic for 10m and confirm stable. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/inference/5xx-mitigation
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by maria — status: investigating.
maria: Handoff: I'll delegate primary watch to jon for 1 hour while i draft customer impact notes. @jon you're the active owner for monitoring and postmortem lead.
jon (sre): Taking ownership. I'll post a status update in 15m with metrics and logs. :thumbsup:
maria: Marked delegation in PD. Sam, update customers with ETA ~15m for recovery.
sam (cust-success): Will do. Using the standard outage template, will include mitigation steps and expected follow-up.
incident-bot: Automation: 5xx rate normalized to <0.5% (6 minutes after mitigation). Will auto-check for 10m before suggesting resolution.
jon (sre): Confirmed stability for 12m, no regressions across regions. Creating postmortem stub and attaching timeline + logs. maria, please add customer impact summary.
maria: Will add customer list + messages. Thanks team. Closing Slack coordination channel. PD incident will be resolved in the console once we finish notes. :white_check_mark:
